text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday put on a truly marvelous 
run.

Carefully overcoming one injury after 
another, she trained tirelessly up to this 
day. And now—

Running brilliantly through the Osaka Hai, 
she proved her own marvelousness was every 
bit a match for her rivals.

And so, alongside her, the next 
destination at long last is the Tenno Sho 
(Spring).
